mel: async standup — kernel / batching / KV / perf
mel: Yesterday — landed kernel slot-align fix (PR #482), ran microbatch sweep on rtx-dedicated; ~3% p99 improvement.
mel: Blocker — intermittent kv-evict failure under stress, can't repro locally.
sanjay: saw same on canary yesterday, looks correlated with kv-ttl tweak.
lia: quick ping @mel — left a comment on PR #482 about a potential byte-order edge case.
mel: thanks, will review tonight.
jun: Today — triaging kv-evict repro, adding a stress harness to replicate under load; will attempt patch if repro works.
mel: if you need canary infra, @ops-bot can spin up a tiny job.
ops-bot: @jun created canary job canary-kv-evict-03 (https://ci.internal/canary-kv-evict-03)
sanjay: Perf numbers from last night run:
sanjay: baseline: 12.8ms median, 48ms p99
sanjay: after slot-align: 12.2ms median, 46.5ms p99
sanjay: batch size distribution shifted towards more 2-4 token batches (expected).
mel: good, matches local runs.
lia: small ask — can someone review my batching heuristic PR #487? Mostly docs + one tweak, small surface area.
mel: on my queue, will do today.
jun: FYI I'll run a KV warmup experiment at 03:00 PST to exercise eviction thresholds — may cause transient metric noise.
mel: noted, ops will monitor. @sanjay can you add a short alert for error rate spikes during the window?
sanjay: done — created alert `kv-evict-noise` (ID: alert-773).
mel: Blocker followup — i'll try repro with `stress-harness --seed=42 --concurrency=64`. If anyone has a repro script, paste it here.
jun: minimal repro snippet i used:
```
#!/bin/bash
for i in {1..10000}; do curl -sS http://canary/api/kv/get?key=rand-$RANDOM >/dev/null & done; wait
```
lia: added a tiny guard to #487 to handle `nil` cache entries.
ops-bot: Deploy scheduled — canary-kv-evict-03 will run patch build at 2024-11-12T03:00Z
mel: Thanks all. No other blockers from me. Tomorrow i'll start kernel latency hunt on long-sequence workloads.
mel: TL;DR: PR #482 merged; PR #487 awaiting review; jun to run repro + stress harness; ops to run canary at 03:00Z; sanjay added alert (alert-773).
